models.why: The same RTX 3090 went from ~82 t/s baseline to ~114 t/s with optimized MTP, ~138 t/s with DFlash2 plus context lookup, and 381 t/s with longer verification on prefix-cached prompts — no GPU upgrade, all of it execution stack.

engines.quant: DFlash2 + context lookup + prefix caching and longer verification; only reached on workloads that reuse text from the input context (ordinary chat on this stack ~133 t/s)
